title: June 15, 2015 Regional Affordability Committee Regular Meeting
transcript:
THE REGIONAL AFFORDABILITY COMMITTEE WILL MEET ON 
MONDAY, JUNE 15, 2015 AT 3:00 PM 
AUSTIN CITY HALL 
301 W. SECOND STREET 
AUSTIN, TEXAS 
 
 
AGENDA 
 
 
The Regional Affordability Committee may go into a closed session under the Open Meetings Act, 
Section 551.071, of the Texas Government Code, to receive advice from legal counsel on any item 
on this agenda. 
 
CALL TO ORDER 
 
 
Approval of Minutes 
 
1. 
Approve the minutes of the Regional Affordability Committee meeting of 
May 18, 2015. 
 
 
Citizen Communication: General 
 
2. 
The first five speakers signed up prior to the meeting being called to order 
will each be allowed three minutes to address their concerns regarding items 
not posted on the agenda. 
 
 
Staff Briefing 
 
3. 
Presentation on the findings of the 6th annual Community Action Network 
(CAN) Dashboard Report. 
 
4. 
Presentation by Conversation Corps related to the July Conversation Corps 
meeting on housing affordability. 
 
 
Discussion and Possible Action 
 
5. 
Discussion of guiding principles related to the strategic plan for the Regional 
Affordability Committee and consider a strategic work plan for the year. 
 
 
6. 
Discussion of interlocal agreements between participating taxing entities and 
possible collaborations. 
 
7. 
Discussion of creation of a taxpayer impact statement. 
 
 
Future Items 
 
8. 
Discussion of future agenda items. 
 
ADJOURN 
 
 
 
 
The City of Austin is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. 
Reasonable modifications and equal access to communications will be provided upon request. 
For assistance, please call 512-974-2210 or TTY users route through 711.  
 
A person may request a Spanish language interpreter be made available by contacting the Office of 
the City Clerk not later than twenty-four hours before the scheduled time of the item on which the 
person wishes to speak.  Please call (512) 974-2210 in advance or inform the City Clerk’s staff 
present at the council meeting. 
 
Cualquier persona puede solicitar servicios de intérprete en español comunicándose con la oficina del 
Secretario/a Municipal a no más tardar de veinte y cuatro  horas antes de la hora determinada para el 
asunto sobre el cual la persona desea comentar. Por favor llame al (512) 974-2210 con anticipo o 
informe al personal del Secretario/a Municipal presente en la sesión del Consejo.
